verdict.rationale: BILL's own docs say the API Reference shows sample code in a choice of languages and lets users test API calls directly in the documentation. Interactive recipes run against sandbox credentials and chain endpoint outputs, and a forkable Postman collection adds another runnable path. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the in-docs try-it console works, and detail on the console's scope (endpoint coverage, auth handling).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The API Reference section enables you to view sample code in your choice of language and also test API calls in the documentation.
In each recipe, you enter your sandbox account credentials and learn how the output of an API endpoint forms the input of another endpoint.
Simply fork the collection from the Postman API Network and begin testing with different BILL v3 API workflows.
